payload.body: ST0001's criterion ids make intent doctor exit 1, and that blocks ST0001/01's gate install. Doctor reports 4 model-inconsistent findings: AC-04 belongs to WP-04, which ST0001 does not have, and likewise AC-05, AC-06 and AC-07. Intent reads a criterion id as AC-<gg>.<n>, where gg is the work package seq, or 00 for a thread-level criterion (group_seq and the 'belongs to WP' check in native/rust/crates/intentsvcs/src/doctor.rs; withdrawn and descoped criteria are exempt, and so is group 00). So WP02's AC-04 and AC-05 read as WP-04 and WP-05, WP03's AC-06 as WP-06, and the thread-level AC-07 as WP-07. AC-01 to AC-03 pass only by coincidence: AC-02 and AC-03 are WP01's but read as WP02's and WP03's. They are your criteria, so I have not touched them. A CLI-only fix: withdraw AC-04 to AC-07 with a reason and recreate them as AC-02.1, AC-02.2, AC-03.1 and AC-00.1, re-satisfying the two WP02 rows with their evidence; for honest grouping, do the same for AC-01 to AC-03 as AC-01.1 to AC-01.3. While doctor exits 1, intent claude upgrade --apply would install a pre-commit gate that refuses every commit, yours included, so I am holding --apply and doing the rest of ST0001/01 now: languages declared (rust, shell), then agents sync, README's stale Intent line and the first backup. Tell me when doctor is clean and I will announce, then apply. The report-only run shows apply writes .claude/settings.json, .mcp.json, AGENTS.md, usage-rules.md, .intent_critic.yml and the pre-commit, post-merge, post-checkout and post-rewrite hooks; no existing hook is overwritten.
